name: LLaMP
demonstrated_target: Si crystal/interstitial and crystal annealing MD
boundary_conditions: crystalline supercells demonstrated; PBC not separately audited

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Fetches a crystal, constructs a supercell, runs temperature-cycling ML-potential MD and analyzes its trajectory.

name: ChemReasoner
boundary_conditions: slab cells and vacuum explicitly reported

sources.evidence_paraphrase: LLM-guided catalyst search uses GNN structure relaxation and adsorption-energy feedback; selected slabs are checked by DFT.

name: AtomAgents
boundary_conditions: explicit periodic boundaries; dislocation cells also have a free direction

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Runs alloy property calculations, atomic relaxation and dislocation NEB; material-property experiments link simulation feedback to alloy hypotheses.

name: Adsorb-Agent
boundary_conditions: bulk-derived Miller-index slabs; explicit PBC not independently checked

sources.evidence_paraphrase: LLM proposes adsorption sites and orientations, with relaxed atomistic adsorption-energy evaluation. Bulk IDs and slab Miller indices are documented.

name: MDCrow
boundary_conditions: not resolved from inspected article; do not assume isolated molecules

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Executes OpenMM MD and MDTraj analysis on protein tasks including temperature comparisons; demonstrated scope is biomolecular simulation.

name: MDAgent
boundary_conditions: not resolved from inspected article

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Generates, executes and reviews LAMMPS simulation code for material thermodynamic tasks.

limitations: Semi-automated: the paper explicitly retains human involvement. It is included because the scope includes LLM modification/execution, not only fully autonomous agents.

name: El Agente Q
boundary_conditions: finite molecular calculations (ORCA/xTB)

sources.locator: Abstract; corroborated by ChemGraph Discussion and Quntur Introduction
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Quantum chemistry workflows include equilibrium geometries, vibrational/spectral and electronic-property calculations, with adaptive debugging.

aliases: El Agente: An Autonomous Agent for Quantum Chemistry

name: Aitomia
boundary_conditions: finite molecular examples; no periodic demonstration coded

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Demonstrated examples include hexanol IR and multi-species reaction enthalpy workflows using geometry optimization, frequency and electronic calculations.

limitations: The inspected preprint and current repository are distinct evidence versions. The current repository supports TS/IRC; no negative capability claim follows from uncoded tasks here.

name: ChemGraph
demonstrated_target: PubChem small molecules and reaction thermochemistry
boundary_conditions: finite molecular benchmarks; ASE supports PBC but support is not counted as a demonstration

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Thirteen molecular tasks include DFT optimization, vibrations and reaction enthalpy/Gibbs calculations; no periodic benchmark is inferred from ASE support.

name: DREAMS
boundary_conditions: periodic crystal/lattice-constant and crystalline slab models

sources.locator: Main text; Sol27LC and CO/Pt(111) challenges
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Executes lattice-constant and adsorption-energy studies with DFT workflows and provenance checking.

name: VASPilot
boundary_conditions: band structure/Brillouin-zone crystalline models

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Demonstrates band structures, density of states, cutoff convergence, lattice-constant optimization and band-gap comparisons.

name: MASTER
demonstrated_target: CO on Cu(100) adatoms and M–N–C catalysts
boundary_conditions: explicit 4×4 periodic six-layer Cu(100) slab

sources.locator: Computational methods; Fig.2; Supplementary geometry tips
sources.evidence_paraphrase: LLM reasoning chooses catalyst candidates and executes atomistic adsorption-energy simulations; Cu(100) geometry is explicitly periodic.

name: Masgent
boundary_conditions: crystal/supercell/slab models documented

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Agent executes LaCoO3 vacancy construction and MLP defect-energy workflow. VASP workflows are prepared; the agent does not directly execute VASP.

limitations: Do not equate VASP input preparation with completed VASP calculations; task marks refer to demonstrated MLP/structure work.

name: El Agente Estructural
demonstrated_target: molecules, organometallic complexes and TS-like geometries
boundary_conditions: finite molecular cases; slabs/solids are future extensions in inspected v1

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Invokes xTB constrained optimization to create intended molecular geometry; agentic geometric operations are real. Subsequent independent DFT TS checks are not coded as agent TS execution.

limitations: Included despite editor emphasis because xTB constrained relaxation is an actual quantum-chemical computation, beyond pure string/generative molecular design.

name: El Agente Quntur
boundary_conditions: finite molecular cases including isocyanide and acetylacetone

sources.locator: Results/case studies; Discussion/Geometric reasoning; Appendix B
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Demonstrates electronic methods, optimization/frequencies and reaction-path cases; isocyanide mechanistic refinement includes TS correction. NEB geometry failures are discussed, so this is task coverage rather than blanket success.

name: MatSciAgent
demonstrated_target: Al and NiAl crystal MD; auxiliary continuum tasks
boundary_conditions: FCC and CIF-derived crystalline models; explicit PBC not independently audited

sources.locator: Molecular dynamics Case 1; Joint Implementation; Figs.11–12
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Executes Al NVE MD and CIF-generated NiAl NVT MD; continuum-only examples do not determine inclusion.

name: PolyJarvis
boundary_conditions: condensed simulation cells; self-imaging/PPPM documented; PBC wording not separately resolved

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Builds polymer cells and orchestrates equilibration, cooling, density, glass-transition and mechanical-property MD workflows.

name: El Agente Forjador
boundary_conditions: finite molecular examples; quantum-state dynamics does not imply periodic materials

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Creates and reuses tools for molecular optimization, frequencies/thermochemistry and excited states; hybrid cases couple electronic structure to quantum dynamics.

limitations: D is quantum dynamics, not necessarily atomistic MD. The physical target is coded by demonstrated molecular calculations, not software breadth.

name: TSAgent
boundary_conditions: VASP slab geometry; 2×2×1 k-point grid explicitly reported

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Adapts geometry optimization, NEB and vibrational TS verification on OC20NEB surface-reaction cases.

name: CatDT
boundary_conditions: slab/bulk/facet construction with gas–solid and liquid–solid models

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Builds catalyst surfaces, proposes mechanisms, searches paths/TS and computes kinetics using atomistic tools; liquid–solid capability is not finite-molecule evidence.

name: MDForge
boundary_conditions: not resolved from inspected article; explicit/implicit solvent workflow details need separate audit

sources.evidence_paraphrase: LLM writes and refines MD pipelines with physics feedback on host–guest binding benchmarks.

name: AdsMind
boundary_conditions: cell and periodic boundary conditions explicitly retained in ASE slab reconstruction

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Closed-loop agent uses MLFF relaxation feedback to revise adsorption hypotheses. Main benchmark has Langevin warmup disabled; no MD mark is assigned.

name: Agent-MD
boundary_conditions: explicit periodic boundaries in all three directions

sources.evidence_paraphrase: LLM reasoning supports campaign construction and event review around deterministic GCMC–MD; production cycles need no live LLM invocation.

limitations: Selective LLM placement is included; counting requires actual planning/modification decisions, not a live LLM at every MD step.

name: Evolving TS workflows
boundary_conditions: finite molecular endpoint/TS geometries

sources.evidence_paraphrase: LLM evolves TS-search code; execution feedback includes Hessian and IRC endpoint checks. The LLM optimizes the workflow rather than directly making every reaction decision.

name: ARCHE
boundary_conditions: finite molecular asymmetric, radical and Ni-catalysis examples

sources.locator: Abstract; SI TSPipeline/C.10 independently checked by parent researcher
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Closed-loop mechanistic hypotheses are checked computationally across stereocontrol, radical cleavage and Ni-catalyzed selectivity examples.

limitations: Full PDF exceeds web-reader size limit; main inclusion/object/task claims use the abstract. Parent independently inspected SI mapping/force-field/TS and frequency/IRC/endpoint chain. Do not infer absent geometric or scientific validation capabilities.

name: Multireference QC agent
demonstrated_target: QUEST molecular excited states and transition-metal complexes
boundary_conditions: finite molecular ORCA calculations

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Selects active spaces, submits ORCA calculations, recovers convergence and identifies electronic states; evaluation covers molecular vertical transition energies.
